system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Animal Handling and Athletics, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Stabling Lore, Animal Husbandry Lore, Equine Anatomy Lore.
system.description: You cared for mounts and worked wherever a stable needed strong hands. You learned to approach a nervous animal patiently and recognize trouble before a saddle ever touched its back.
